blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.
blocks.zh: "从诗到视频"的生成需要的不仅仅是将文字翻译成视觉场景. 诗歌语言被高度压缩,常常依赖于历史和文化知识,并经常通过比喻,图像等非文学表达来表达意义. 我们引入了PoVi,这是一个基于诗歌到视频生成的基准和代理框架,评价语义定位、话语一致性和视听实现。 PoVi将"诗语义"重建为以证据为界的代表作,并逐渐将其转化为叙事,诠释,人物资产,并有镜头级的视觉计划,再由叙事相接的视频生成. 在三个规划主干线和四个视频发电机中,PoVi在单调生成上不断改进,在隐含背景知识和比喻关系上收益最大. PoVi提供了一个测试台,用于研究超越直接文本到视频合成的基于知识的长视多模式生成.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent video generation models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity, temporal consistency, and controllability Blattmann et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Bar-Tal et al. (2024) . Modern systems can synthesize complex motion Kondratyuk et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Polyak et al. (2024) , maintain subjects across shots Gao et al. (2025) ; Seedance et al. (2026) ; ByteDance Seed Team (2026) ; Zhou et al. (2024) , and increasingly support multimodal references Wang et al. (2023) ; Jiang et al. (2025) and filmmaking-oriented controls. Yet these advances largely assume that the input already specifies, at least approximately, what should appear on screen Tian et al. (2024) , leaving the main challenge as faithfully generating the specified content.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频生成模型在视觉忠实,时间一致性,可控性布拉特曼等人(2023年),陈等人(2024年),杨等人(2025年),巴塔尔等人(2024年)方面取得了显著进展. 现代系统可以合成复杂运动的Kondratyuk等人(2023年);Zhang等人(2025年);Polyak等人(2024年),在Gao等人(2025年);种子等人(2026年);ByteDance。 种子团队(2026);周等人(2024),并日益支持多模式参考王等人(2023);江等人(2025)和面向电影制作的控制. 然而,这些进展基本上假定,投入至少大致已经具体说明了屏幕天等人(2024年)应显示的内容,而主要挑战在于忠实地生成特定内容。

blocks.en: Classical poetry poses a fundamentally different problem. A poem is not a visual specification, but a highly compressed literary representation in which characters, settings, causal relations, historical background, and even the referents of salient imagery may remain unstated Chen et al. (2025) ; Chiu et al. (2025) . A few lines may presuppose an episode from a poet’s life, compress several events into a single poetic image, or use a concrete object as the source of a metaphor whose target is never explicitly named Tong et al. (2024) ; Sanchez-Bayona and Agerri (2025) . Faithful interpretation therefore requires both knowledge grounding , to recover historical and cultural context beyond the poem itself, and figurative understanding , to resolve metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions within it. Directly prompting a video generator with the poem may therefore produce visually plausible but interpretively shallow results: surface imagery is rendered, while the background, narrative progression, or figurative meaning is lost Mao et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2024) . Poetry-to-video generation thus requires first determining what should be rendered , before deciding how to render it.
blocks.zh: 古典诗歌提出了根本不同的问题. 诗歌不是视觉规格,而是高度压缩的文学表现,其中人物,环境,因果关系,历史背景,甚至显著图像的参考人物可能仍未被描述为陈等人(2025年);Chiu等人(2025年). 几行可能以诗人一生的一集为先决条件,将数个事件压缩成单一的诗体形象,或者用一个具体物体作为比喻的源头,其目标从未被明确命名为Tong等人(2024年);桑切斯-巴约纳和阿格里(2025年). 因此,忠实的诠释既要求知识扎根,要求恢复诗歌本身以外的历史和文化背景,也要求象征性的理解,以解决其中的比喻、图像和其他非文学表达。 因此,用诗歌直接引导视频生成者可能会产生可视的、但解释性很浅的结果:表面图像被渲染出来,而背景、叙事进展或象征意义则丢失了Mao等人(2024年);Jiang等人(2024年)。 因此,诗歌到视频的生成需要首先确定应该提供什么,然后决定如何提供。

blocks.en: Recent agentic video generation systems organize video creation through stories, scripts, storyboards, and shot plans, but typically assume that the intended content is already sufficiently specified. Poetry introduces an additional challenge: before directing can begin, the system must first recover implicit characters, events, historical context, and figurative relations, and determine what information should be conveyed. It must then organize this understanding into a coherent narration and visual plan before realizing it as synchronized audiovisual content. Errors at the understanding stage cannot be corrected by a stronger video generator if the intended meaning has never been made explicit. As illustrated in Figure 1 , poetry-to-video therefore requires a progression from understanding , through directing , to audiovisual realization .
blocks.zh: 近期的代理视频生成系统通过故事,脚本,故事板,以及拍摄计划来组织视频创作,但一般认为预期内容已经足够明确. "诗经"提出了另一个挑战:在引导开始之前,系统必须首先恢复隐含的人物,事件,历史背景,以及虚构的关系,并确定应该传递哪些信息. 然后,它必须把这种理解组织成一个连贯的叙述和视觉计划,然后将其变成同步的视听内容。 如果意向从未明确,则更强大的视频生成器无法纠正理解阶段的错误。 因此,如图1所示,诗歌对视频需要从理解(通过引导)发展到视听实现。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison between vanilla text-to-video generation and poetry-to-video generation. Unlike ordinary text prompts, poetry requires understanding implicit meaning, directing how that meaning should be communicated, and realizing the resulting plan as aligned audiovisual content.

blocks.en: We further propose an evidence bounded multi agent framework in which a knowledge planning agent constructs a semantic director graph that organizes historical context, causal relations, metaphorical mappings, and visual constraints with supporting evidence. Role specialized agents then convert this representation into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans. PoVi further uses measured narration duration to align clips, speech, subtitles, and transitions. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently outperforms single call generation. The largest gains occur on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations, showing that poetry to video generation depends on recovering and organizing the meaning that the video should convey.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步提出一个以证据为界限的多剂框架,在这个框架中,知识规划代理人构建一个语义导图,将历史背景,因果关系,比喻性映射,视觉约束与辅助证据联系起来. 然后,角色专门人员将这种表现转化为叙述、解释、人物资产和镜头级视觉计划。 PoVi进一步使用测量的叙述时间来对齐剪辑,语音,字幕和过渡. 在三个规划主干线和四个视频发电机中,PoVi一直超越单一呼叫生成。 最大的收获在于隐含的背景知识和隐喻关系,表明诗歌对视频生成的依赖恢复和组织视频应表达的意义.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follow: • We formulate poetry-to-video as grounded multimodal generation and introduce PoVi-Bench for comprehensive evaluation. • We propose an evidence-bounded multi-agent framework for semantic reconstruction, directing, and narration-aligned video generation. • PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, especially on background knowledge and metaphorical relations.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Text-to-Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 文本到视频生成

blocks.en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have greatly improved visual fidelity, temporal coherence, and overall controllability. Models such as HunyuanVideo Kong et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2025) , Wan Wan et al. (2025) , CogVideoX Yang et al. (2025) , Veo Wiedemer et al. (2025) , Seedance Seedance et al. (2026) ; ByteDance Seed Team (2026) , and MiniMax H3 MiniMax AI (2026) support increasingly complex, coherent, and controllable video generation. However, conventional T2V largely assumes that the input already specifies what should appear on screen. Classical poetry violates this assumption, as key characters, events, contexts, and figurative meanings may remain implicit. Poetry-to-video therefore requires first recovering what should be rendered before determining how to render it .
blocks.zh: 文本到视频生成的最新进展大大提高了视觉的忠诚性、时间一致性和总体可控性。 HunyuanVideo Kong等人(2024年);Wu等人(2025年);Wan Wan等人(2025年),CogVideoX。 Yang等人(2025年)、Veo Wiedemer等人(2025年)、种子等(2026年);ByteDance 种子团队(2026年),和MiniMax H3 MiniMax AI(2026年)支持日益复杂,连贯,可控的视频生成. 然而,传统的T2V基本上假设输入已经指定了屏幕上应该显示的内容. 古典诗歌违反了这一假设,因为关键人物,事件,背景,和象征意义可能仍然隐含. 因此,在决定如何制作之前,必须首先收回应提供的东西。

blocks.en: 2.2 Poetry Understanding and Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 诗歌理解和创作

blocks.en: Classical Chinese poetry has been extensively studied in language generation and understanding due to its compressed semantics, formal constraints, cultural references, and historical allusions. Recent LLM-based systems such as CharPoet Yu et al. (2024) and PoeTone Qu et al. (2026) explore controlled poetry generation, while Jiuge-Tuiqiao Han et al. (2026) incorporates classical encyclopedic knowledge and historical poetic evidence for knowledge-grounded and interpretable refinement. Nevertheless, most existing work remains within the text-to-text paradigm, focusing on generation, revision, appreciation, or explanation.
blocks.zh: 古典中国诗歌因其压缩语义,形式约束,文化参考,以及历史暗示,在语言生成和理解方面被广泛研究. 最近基于LLM的系统,如CharPoet Yu等人(2024年)和PoeTone Qu等人. (2026年)探索受控诗歌创作,而Jiuge-Tuiqiao Han等人(2026年)则将古典百科全书知识和历史诗歌证据纳入其中,用于知识基础和可诠释的完善. 尽管如此,大多数现有工作仍停留在文本对文本的范式之内,侧重于生成、修订、赞赏或解释。

blocks.en: Recent efforts such as Poetry2Image Jiang et al. (2024) use iterative LLM-based correction to improve the completeness and semantic consistency of poetry-conditioned images, while SE2Image Wang et al. (2025) separates scene and emotion descriptions to guide image generation. These works highlight the need for semantic grounding before visual generation, but remain limited to static outputs. Poetry-to-video additionally requires temporal and narrative planning, including event ordering, scene transitions, and coordination between narration and visual content.
blocks.zh: 近期的努力如"诗歌2Image Jiang et al"(2024)采用基于迭代LLM的校正,以提高诗歌条件图像的完整性和语义一致性,而SE2Image Wang et al. (2025)将场景和情感描述分开,以指导图像生成. 这些作品凸显出在视觉生成之前需要语义定位,但仍限于静态输出. 诗歌到视频还需要时间和叙事规划,包括事件顺序,场景过渡,以及叙事和视觉内容之间的协调.

blocks.zh: 2.3 代理长式视频生成

(2026) , and OpenMontage OpenMontage (2026) further introduce agentic planning and production, while FilmWorld Zuo et al. (2026) incorporates persistent cinematic world modeling.

blocks.en: Poetry introduces an additional stage before directing: the system must first recover implicit characters, events, emotions, and cultural context, then decide how this meaning should be distributed across narration and visuals. PoVi therefore extends agentic filmmaking with an explicit semantic reconstruction stage that bridges literary interpretation and downstream video generation.

blocks.en: 4.3 Metric Suite

blocks.en: We define 17 primary metrics across three dimensions: semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization (Figure 2 ). Coverage and correctness metrics are scored in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , while quality metrics use a 1–5 rubric and are normalized.

Table 2 reports the eight narration metrics. PoVi scores 0.11 0.11 higher than the baseline on Gemini, 0.12 0.12 on DeepSeek and 0.18 0.18 on Seed-2.0-Lite. A single call has to recall the poet’s history, choose what to say about it, and write the narration in one pass. Splitting those steps apart helps a weak model more than a strong one. The gain comes mostly from what the poem leaves out. S1 asks whether the narration covers the background a faithful explanation needs; it rises by 0.17 0.17 to 0.23 0.23 on every backbone. S4 asks why a metaphor’s source licenses its target;

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented PoVi, a benchmark and framework for poetry-to-video generation. Its evaluation protocol separately assesses semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization against frozen annotations, preventing systems from explaining figurative meaning while visualizing only literal imagery. PoVi first reconstructs a poem’s meaning, distinguishes model-recalled knowledge from documented evidence, and then converts this grounded interpretation into narration, character assets, shot-level plans, and temporally aligned audiovisual content. Across multiple planning backbones, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with larger gains for weaker backbones. Video results show a similar trend: weaker generators benefit most from explicit semantic and shot-level planning, while stronger generators leave less room for improvement once the content is explicit. These findings show that stronger rendering alone cannot determine what a poem requires the video to communicate.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PoVi,这是诗歌到视频一代的基准和框架。 其评价协议分别对照冷冻说明评估语义定位、话语一致性和视听实现,防止系统在只可视化文字图像的同时解释象征意义。 PoVi首先重建了一首诗的意义,区分了模型所谓的知识与文献证据,然后将这种有根据的解释转换为叙述,人物资产,镜头级计划,以及时间上一致的视听内容. 在整个多个规划骨干部门,PoVi在单调发电方面不断改进,对较弱骨干部门的收益更大。 视频结果表明类似趋势:较弱的发电机从明确的语义和射程规划中受益最大,而较强的发电机在内容明确后留下的改进余地较小。 这些调查结果表明,单靠更强的渲染无法决定诗作需要什么视频来交流.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: PoVi-Bench is deliberately balanced across Tang poetry, Song ci , and three difficulty levels. Nevertheless, its 120 works cannot fully capture the authorial, historical, and formal diversity of classical Chinese poetry. Automatic evaluation by Gemini-3.5-Flash shows moderate agreement with human ratings but saturates on some visual metrics. We therefore use human ratings as the reference. Finally, PoVi requires eight model calls per poem before repairs, compared with one call for the baseline, increasing computational cost.
